steps: Perspective/orthographic switches preserve target-plane scale and model matrices; switching back restores exact perspective uploads without source writes.
Actual orthographic GPU projection keeps equal-size segments identical at three depths. Selected/all focus and wheel zoom preserve orthographic mode and heading.

Real pointer panning in free heading and all six directions preserves orientation/depth; independent reprojection checks actual uploaded GPU matrices against CSS drag at every depth for all three objects. Panning does not select or write source.

Shift-left and middle mouse pan temporarily while the dropdown stays orbit. Ordinary orbit dragging still rotates; pan double-taps never select/focus; switching to orbit selects the intended box at its new projected location.
Reset retains both projection and drag mode while restoring the authored camera; choosing perspective restores exact original GPU matrices.
An invalid edited source keeps native diagnostics and disables exact source location; panning continues on the last valid model without saving or clearing that diagnostic.

A new unsaved model uses its complete new bounds. Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px preserve drag-mode controls; real single-finger panning works, source text and scrollable controls; all 24 corners fit each actual resized GPU viewport.
Closing disposes the view. Reopening reads the current unsaved draft and frames it; author files retain their original bytes throughout.
Injected WebGL unavailability disables only view controls, keeps verified declarations and does not change author files.
limitations: Real HTTP editor, native/WASM source semantics and WebGL2 draws/readPixels; no installed desktop, Android or hardware-GPU claim.

Chrome flags and renderer/vendor are recorded explicitly. This run pins ANGLE/SwiftShader; the automatic headless fallback exhibited compositor corruption in a separate retained comparison. No hardware-GPU claim.
Unsupported-renderer phase injects getContext(webgl2)=null only; all source semantics and editor Save remain real.
Orthographic projection and gestures only navigate the last valid preview; no author camera or source writes. Instrumentation records actual uploaded matrices and forwards WebGL calls unchanged.
